name: Lionel Garcia
catch: Full-stack Data Scientist with experience developing GPU-optimized machine learning tools, data analysis workflows, web app and pipelines for large-scale time-series and image processing.

experience.title: Freelance - Scientific Software Development
description: Developed a web platform that allow students to remotely control robotic telescopes located around the world. This includes frontend, scheduling and data processing backend.

experience.title: Center for Computational Astrophysics – Research Fellow
description: Developed a suite of models to analyze large astronomical time-series datasets ([jaxoplanet](https://github.com/exoplanet-dev/jaxoplanet)), an ML algorithm to detect faint signals in time-series dominated by red noise ([nuance](https://github.com/lgrcia/nuance)), and a framework to efficiently model spherical surfaces (stars) ([spotter](https://github.com/lgrcia/spotter)). These tools are powered by JAX, optimized for GPUs/TPUs, and used in the context of Bayesian modeling, inference and machine learning applications.
Led a high-impact [scientific program](https://www.stsci.edu/jwst-program-info/program/?program=5799) with the James Webb Space Telescope, managing a team of 15 scientists.

experience.title: University of Liège – Graduate Research Assistant
description: Developed astronomical image processing pipelines ([prose](https://github.com/lgrcia/prose)), a pattern matching algorithm for stellar asterisms ([twirl](https://github.com/lgrcia/twirl)), and a deep learning model to process stars images ([ballet](https://huggingface.co/lgrcia/ballet))

Maintained and remotely operated large robotic telescopes for the [SPECULOOS](https://www.speculoos.uliege.be/cms/c_4259452/en/speculoos?id=c_4259452) project. Developed a fully automated image processing pipeline running daily to transform raw data into scientific products. Built and maintained web dashboards for data analysis monitoring and visualization (40 users).

experience.title: European Space Agency – Engineer
description: Applied machine learning to collect data and predict costs for future space missions.

experience.title: CERN – Technical Student
description: Designed the [data analysis workflow](https://github.com/lgrcia/BWS-diagnostic) for calibrating a Large Hadron Collider instrument.

education.degree: PhD in Astronomy – University of Liège
